thread:
jamie_cs: Heads-up: Aurum Analytics is onboarding and running a press demo in APAC next Wed 09:00 SGT. Their staging run is hitting qps and token limits. They're asking for a 48h temporary throughput bump + two CIDRs + SNI allow for a proxy passthrough. Renewal check in 12 days so we want this to go smoothly.

leo_infra: Can you share exact CIDRs, window, region preference, and the model slug so we can scope the grant to the model? Also confirm whether they need IPv6.

jamie_cs: Owner is kelsey@aurum.ai. Window: 2026-05-20T01:00Z -> 2026-05-22T01:00Z (48h). Peak bursts ~2600 qps, steady ~1300. CIDRs: 3.120.45.0/24 and 34.80.0.0/15. IPv6: optional; they provided 2600:1400:abcd::/48 if needed. SNI: demo.tls.aurum.ai. Region: asia-southeast-1 preferred. Model: aurum/demo-v3 -> redwood/gpt-medium-v3-staging. They also want prefix caching and sticky sessions for demo accounts.

ops-bot: @leo_infra created ticket OPS-7120: "Aurum APAC onboarding demo temporary burst + CIDR+SNI allow". Approval SLA: 2h. Link: https://redwood.ops/OPS-7120

leo_infra: I'll reserve a burst pool and add the CIDRs + SNI to the proxy allowlist. We'll limit the grant to the model slug and those identifiers only. Anya, can you pre-warm KV cache and bump concurrency? Also set batch_max_tokens=512 for demo scripts.

anya_se: On it. Plan: warm top-15 prompt prefixes, set concurrency=28, batch_max_tokens=512, prefix_cache TTL=600s, and enable session-affinity cookie for sticky routing. I'll spin up a geo-warmed canary in asia-southeast-1 and run a smoke harness.

leo_infra: Adding note: customer requested encrypted log forwarding to their KMS key for demo metrics. We'll scope that to a read-only export and note in OPS ticket. Estimated uplift ~$1.6k for 48h including geo burst and proxy changes.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment queued: canary/redwood-gpt-medium-v3-warm -> asia-southeast-1. ETA ~16m.

leo_infra: Small hiccup on initial canary: proxy rejected SNI due to missing passthrough rule. Applied TLS passthrough for demo.tls.aurum.ai and re-run warm.

deploy-bot: Canary deployed successfully. Warm logs: `kv_cache_hits=97% ; p95_latency=210ms ; sticky_sessions=OK`.

ops-bot: OPS-7120 updated: CIDRs 3.120.45.0/24, 34.80.0.0/15 (+ optional IPv6 2600:1400:abcd::/48) and SNI demo.tls.aurum.ai added to proxy allowlist; burst pool allocated in asia-southeast-1; KMS-forwarding scoped; auto-revoke scheduled 2026-05-22T01:10Z.

harry_ae: Noted. I'll capture the uplift and demo success as a renewal momentum item. If they request extension I'll draft amendment language.

leo_infra: Closing OPS-7120 as provisioned. We'll auto-revoke and remove CIDRs/SNI at scheduled time unless extension requested. All rollback steps documented in ticket.

jamie_cs: Confirmed with customer: smoke passed at 08:30 SGT, demo at 09:00 SGT succeeded and they shared a short clip. AE @harry_ae adding to renewal notes. Thanks team! :tada:
